questions.explanation: For a magnetic circuit the governing relation is mmf = R Phi, and flux remains continuous around the loop even where a gap adds reluctance. Permeability varies with saturation, and reluctance is set by path length, cross-sectional area and material, so neither can simply be ignored.

questions.topic: Reluctance recovered from a measurement
questions.stem: Mmf=80, Phi=4e-4 Wb; find reluctance in A/Wb.
questions.explanation: R=mmf/Phi=80/4e-4=2e5. A common slip is to use Phi/mmf. Reluctance is the ratio of magnetomotive force to flux, the magnetic-circuit counterpart of resistance. A frequent slip is to multiply the given numbers or to invert the ratio, either of which computes a different physical quantity.
